name: cmms-campuscare
description: CampusCare CMMS — IDE201 Group 5 capstone. Root scripts to set up and run both server and client.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate --prefix server && npm run seed --prefix server
scripts.db:setup:prod: npm run migrate --prefix server && npm run seed:prod --prefix server
